subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the replacement character defined by <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> contains multiple views of the same single character.
The front view, side view, and rear view all represent one consistent identity.

Use all views together to preserve:
facial identity,
facial proportions,
hairstyle,
hair volume,
body proportions,
the off-shoulder white outfit,
black bow decoration,
corset lacing,
black lace trim,
sleeve structure,
fabric details,
colors,
materials,
and all distinctive appearance features.

Do not interpret the multiple views in <Picture 1> as multiple people.

<Video 1> is a hybrid structural editing reference.

The normal RGB regions of <Video 1> define the original source scene and must be preserved as strongly as possible, including:
the dark nighttime alley,
industrial corridor,
walls,
doors,
background structures,
red neon lighting,
cool blue lighting,
street lights,
ground,
perspective,
camera position,
camera framing,
camera movement,
depth relationships,
lighting direction,
shadow structure,
and temporal structure.

Do not redesign, clean up, simplify, brighten, or replace the original environment.

The grayscale depth-rendered region corresponds exclusively to the tracked foreground speaking subject selected for replacement.

The grayscale depth region is not appearance information.

Do not reproduce:
grayscale color,
depth-map shading,
black contour,
dark halo,
mask boundary,
or depth texture.

Use the depth-rendered subject strictly as structural and motion guidance for:
body position,
silhouette,
3D volume,
body orientation,
head position,
head rotation,
head movement,
mouth movement,
speaking motion,
facial motion,
eye direction,
neck movement,
shoulder movement,
arm position,
hand position,
hand gesture,
finger direction,
upper-body movement,
gesture timing,
spatial position,
depth ordering,
and temporal motion.

summary:

[single-character replacement + speaking performance + hand-gesture preservation + strict depth-guided reconstruction + source-scene preservation]

Replace only the tracked foreground subject represented by the depth-rendered region in <Video 1> with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>.

The replacement character must strictly follow the original tracked subject's:
body position,
body orientation,
scale,
perspective,
head pose,
head movement,
mouth movement,
speaking rhythm,
facial motion,
eye direction,
arm motion,
hand position,
hand gesture,
finger direction,
upper-body motion,
spatial placement,
and timing.

The hand gestures are important motion information.
Preserve the original timing, direction, height, reach, and spatial relationship of the hands and arms as closely as possible.

The replacement character should appear naturally present inside the original nighttime alley and should inherit the original scene lighting.

Preserve the red and blue environmental lighting on the character naturally while retaining the identity and outfit defined by <Picture 1>.

Preserve all normal RGB regions of <Video 1> as strongly as possible.

Do not modify:
the alley,
walls,
doors,
background structures,
lights,
ground,
camera framing,
camera movement,
perspective,
or scene timing.

The grayscale depth representation must completely disappear and be replaced by the fully rendered <Subject 1>.

Avoid:
original subject identity,
original male facial identity,
original hairstyle,
original black jacket identity,
identity drift,
face instability,
hairstyle changes,
outfit changes,
costume simplification,
character duplication,
extra people,
merged anatomy,
duplicated arms,
duplicated hands,
missing fingers,
broken hands,
incorrect finger direction,
incorrect hand position,
incorrect mouth motion,
incorrect speaking rhythm,
grayscale depth texture,
black outlines,
dark halos,
visible mask boundaries,
background deformation,
environment redesign,
lighting replacement,
camera changes,
and unintended scene changes.

subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the replacement character defined by <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> contains multiple views of the same single female character.
The front view, side view, and rear view all represent one consistent identity.

Use all views together to preserve:
the same facial identity,
silver-gray long hair,
hair length and volume,
facial proportions,
body proportions,
white fitted sleeveless top,
black outer garment,
necklace,
skin tone,
clothing structure,
colors,
materials,
and all distinctive appearance details.

Do not interpret the multiple views in <Picture 1> as multiple people.

<Video 1> is the primary motion and structural reference.

The normal RGB regions of <Video 1> define the source scene and must be preserved as strongly as possible, including:
the blue studio background,
the floor,
the original lighting,
the camera position,
the fixed camera framing,
the perspective,
the lower-left Chinese title graphic,
and the temporal structure.

The grayscale depth-rendered human region in <Video 1> corresponds exclusively to the tracked performer.

The depth-rendered region is authoritative structural and motion guidance.

Do not treat the grayscale depth region as appearance information.

Do not reproduce:
grayscale color,
depth-map shading,
black contours,
dark halos,
mask boundaries,
or depth texture.

motion_instruction:

<Subject 1> must strictly reproduce the full-body movement of the tracked performer in <Video 1>.

The motion is a rapid lateral dodge-step / sidestep demonstration.

The performer begins in a centered upright stance.

During the movement:
the body shifts rapidly sideways,
the feet separate into a wider stance,
the knees bend naturally,
the center of gravity moves laterally,
the torso leans slightly in the direction of movement,
the shoulders follow the body shift,
the arms move naturally for balance,
and the head remains coordinated with the body.

After reaching the lateral position,
the performer quickly recovers back toward the original centered stance.

Preserve the exact movement rhythm from <Video 1>.

If the source motion repeats,
reproduce each repetition with the same:
timing,
lateral travel distance,
foot placement,
stance width,
weight transfer,
torso lean,
arm counterbalance,
recovery speed,
and pause timing.

summary:

[character replacement + strict depth-guided full-body motion reconstruction + source-scene preservation]

Replace only the tracked depth-rendered performer in <Video 1> with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> determines who the character is.

<Video 1> and its depth-rendered human region determine exactly how the character moves.

Motion guidance from <Video 1> has priority over invented animation.

Strictly preserve:
body position,
full-body silhouette,
scale,
orientation,
foot trajectory,
foot contact with the floor,
leg spacing,
knee bending,
center-of-gravity movement,
torso lean,
shoulder motion,
arm motion,
head position,
lateral displacement,
acceleration,
deceleration,
recovery timing,
and frame-by-frame temporal motion.

The replacement character must remain visually consistent with <Picture 1> throughout the entire clip.

The long silver-gray hair and clothing may react naturally to the fast lateral movement,
but must not change the underlying motion trajectory.

Preserve the original blue studio scene as strongly as possible.

The camera remains fixed.
Do not add camera movement.
Do not redesign the environment.
Do not remove or alter the lower-left source graphic outside the tracked subject region.

The grayscale depth representation must completely disappear in the final result and be replaced by a fully rendered <Subject 1>.

avoid:

original performer identity,
original male appearance,
original clothing,
identity drift,
face instability,
hair color changes,
hair shortening,
hairstyle changes,
outfit changes,
character duplication,
extra people,
merged anatomy,
extra arms,
extra legs,
broken limbs,
incorrect foot placement,
foot sliding,
floating feet,
broken knees,
incorrect body balance,
incorrect lateral trajectory,
invented dance movements,
walking forward,
walking backward,
running,
jumping,

punching,

nodes.title: 18｜Ref2VA｜Picture 1 + 单Video 1深度复合 + A1
SHOW｜02 Save Video｜RGB + Depth人物展示

widgets_values:
【统一时间 / 音频规则】
① Video 1 是唯一时间基准；force_rate 固定 24fps。
② frame_load_cap 是唯一需要手动控制的时长上限；实际素材更短时，以实际 loaded_frame_count / loaded_duration 为准。
③ 主 H3 length、Face Refine fps、所有 CreateVideo fps、Face Output Trim duration/fps 全部由 01A 自动跟随。
④ 不再使用固定 5.0s / 5.1667s 作为 Face Refine Trim 时长。
⑤ H3 输入/参考音频保持原样；只有最终展示/保存音频经过 01B 峰值限制到 -1 dBFS，解决 SafeAVSave clipped source audio。
⑥ H3 原生输出为 24fps；建议 frame_load_cap 仍使用合法 H3 时间窗口，且总体保持 4–15 秒范围。

① 输入项保持不变：只输入 Video 1 + Picture 1。
② Video 1 同时进入 SeC 与 VDA：SeC 决定换哪里，VDA 提取整帧灰度深度。
③ 人物区域只做轻外扩：GrowMask=48，避免把人物周围大面积背景一起变成 Depth。
④ Mask 只做轻羽化：Radius 6 / Sigma 2，消除硬描边，但不产生大片黑灰晕染。
⑤ Depth 仅微柔化：Radius 2 / Sigma 0.8，压掉深度轮廓锯齿，不破坏主体结构。
⑥ 最终唯一 Video 1 = 原 RGB 场景 + 轻外扩、轻羽化的 Depth 人物。
⑦ OpenVDN DMD8 主输出保持不变。
⑧ Face Refine：完全照 V48 的 ADDON 结构移植，默认整组关闭；需要时用“KSK｜可选模块｜Face Refine”开启。
⑨ Face Refine 直接复用主流程的正向 Conditioning + 最终 AV Latent，只做人脸 Crop 低去噪二采；主输出不受影响。
⑩ Face Refine V7修正：不再复用主流程非方形AV latent。Face Plan输出512×512画布尺寸，单独创建512×512 H3 AV latent，并让 Picture 1 作为人脸身份参考后再注入Crop。
⑪ Face Refine内部音频只作joint latent占位；最终Candidate仍复用Video 1原音。
⑫ 展示规则：所有多帧 IMAGE batch / 序列帧统一用 CreateVideo → SaveVideo，不再用 Preview Image。RGB+Depth复合、Face Refine检测跟脸、Refined Crop、最终回贴均提供视频观察出口。
⑫ V12：左右 Face Refine 均为独立可选组，默认关闭；左开关只控制左组，右开关只控制右组。主流程若处于 Bypass，对应 Refine 不会再单独参与校验。

nodes.title: SHOW｜02 Save Video｜RGB + Depth人物展示

widgets_values:
【统一时间 / 音频规则】
① Video 1 是唯一时间基准；force_rate 固定 24fps。
② frame_load_cap 是唯一需要手动控制的时长上限；实际素材更短时，以实际 loaded_frame_count / loaded_duration 为准。
③ 主 H3 length、Face Refine fps、所有 CreateVideo fps、Face Output Trim duration/fps 全部由 01A 自动跟随。
④ 不再使用固定 5.0s / 5.1667s 作为 Face Refine Trim 时长。
⑤ H3 输入/参考音频保持原样；只有最终展示/保存音频经过 01B 峰值限制到 -1 dBFS，解决 SafeAVSave clipped source audio。
⑥ H3 原生输出为 24fps；建议 frame_load_cap 仍使用合法 H3 时间窗口，且总体保持 4–15 秒范围。

① 输入项保持不变：只输入 Video 1 + Picture 1。
② Video 1 同时进入 SeC 与 VDA：SeC 决定换哪里，VDA 提取整帧灰度深度。
③ 人物区域只做轻外扩：GrowMask=48，避免把人物周围大面积背景一起变成 Depth。
④ Mask 只做轻羽化：Radius 6 / Sigma 2，消除硬描边，但不产生大片黑灰晕染。
⑤ Depth 仅微柔化：Radius 2 / Sigma 0.8，压掉深度轮廓锯齿，不破坏主体结构。
⑥ 最终唯一 Video 1 = 原 RGB 场景 + 轻外扩、轻羽化的 Depth 人物。
⑦ OpenVDN DMD8 主输出保持不变。
⑧ Face Refine：完全照 V48 的 ADDON 结构移植，默认整组关闭；需要时用“KSK｜可选模块｜Face Refine”开启。
⑨ Face Refine 直接复用主流程的正向 Conditioning + 最终 AV Latent，只做人脸 Crop 低去噪二采；主输出不受影响。
⑩ Face Refine V7修正：不再复用主流程非方形AV latent。Face Plan输出512×512画布尺寸，单独创建512×512 H3 AV latent，并让 Picture 1 作为人脸身份参考后再注入Crop。
⑪ Face Refine内部音频只作joint latent占位；最终Candidate仍复用Video 1原音。
⑫ 展示规则：所有多帧 IMAGE batch / 序列帧统一用 CreateVideo → SaveVideo，不再用 Preview Image。RGB+Depth复合、Face Refine检测跟脸、Refined Crop、最终回贴均提供视频观察出口。

> **参考图负责“它是谁”，Depth 负责“它在哪里、怎么动”，正常彩色原视频负责“哪些场景不能乱改”，提示词负责把三者的职责讲清楚。**

以后统一按下面 7 个部分写：

1. `subject_definitions`：定义 Picture 1 / Picture 2 是谁，三视图必须声明是同一个主体。
2. `video_definition`：定义 Video 1 是原始视频，正常彩色区域属于需要保留的源场景。
3. `depth_guidance`：明确灰色 Depth 只提供结构、位置、姿态、运动和时序，绝不提供最终外观。
4. `subject_mapping`：单人写“只替换被追踪主体”；双人必须写死左/右、前/后或者 Subject 1 / Subject 2 的对应关系。
5. `action_description`：根据原视频实际内容反推动作，不要泛泛写“follow motion”。
6. `summary`：重新用最简洁、最强约束的话描述一次最终任务。
7. `avoid`：针对当前素材写明确禁止项，不能只堆通用负面词。

以后可以直接套这份母版：

```text
subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is the replacement subject defined by <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> contains one or multiple views of the same single subject.
If multiple views are present, all views represent the same identity.

Use all views together to preserve:
identity,
overall appearance,
proportions,
shape,
colors,
materials,
clothing or surface details,
hairstyle or structural details,
and all distinctive visual features.

Do not interpret multiple views in <Picture 1> as multiple subjects.


video_definition:

<Video 1> is the primary source video and hybrid structural editing reference.

The normal RGB regions of <Video 1> define source content that must be preserved as strongly as possible.

Preserve:
the original environment,
background,
unchanged people or objects,
props,
ground,
lighting,
camera position,
camera movement,
framing,
perspective,
spatial layout,
and temporal structure.

Do not redesign or reconstruct normal RGB regions unless required immediately around the edited subject boundary.


depth_guidance:

The grayscale depth-rendered region corresponds exclusively to the tracked subject selected for editing.

The depth-rendered region is not appearance information.

Do not reproduce:
grayscale color,
depth-map shading,
depth texture,
black outlines,
dark halos,
or visible mask boundaries.

Use the depth-rendered region strictly as structural and motion guidance for:
subject position,
silhouette,
3D volume,
orientation,
pose,
scale,
depth ordering,
trajectory,
movement speed,
body or object rotation,
spatial relationship,
interaction timing,
and frame-by-frame temporal motion.

The motion and structure from <Video 1> have priority over invented animation.


subject_mapping:

Replace only the tracked depth-rendered subject.

Do not modify subjects or objects outside the selected depth region.

<Subject 1> must remain mapped to the same tracked target throughout the entire video.

Do not switch identities or transfer <Subject 1> to another subject.


action_description:

The tracked subject performs the following action:

[这里根据原视频实际反推动作]

Describe:
starting position,
main movement,
movement direction,
body/object orientation,
important limb or component motion,
interaction with other subjects or objects,
movement speed,
turning,
acceleration or deceleration,
pause timing,
recovery motion,
and ending position.

The replacement subject must reproduce this action as closely as possible.

Do not add extra actions that are not present in <Video 1>.


summary:

[localized video editing + identity replacement + strict depth-guided motion reconstruction + strong source-scene preservation]

Replace only the tracked depth-rendered subject in <Video 1> with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>.

<Picture 1> determines what the replacement subject looks like.

<Video 1> determines:
where the subject is,
how large it is,
how it is oriented,
how it moves,
how it interacts with the scene,
and when every movement occurs.

Preserve all normal RGB scene regions as strongly as possible.

The grayscale depth representation must completely disappear in the final result and be replaced by a naturally rendered <Subject 1>.


avoid:

original subject identity,
identity drift,
identity switching,
subject duplication,
extra subjects,
merged anatomy or geometry,
incorrect proportions,
incorrect trajectory,
invented movement,
incorrect timing,
incorrect depth relationship,
grayscale depth texture,
black outlines,
dark halos,
visible mask boundaries,
background deformation,
unintended object changes,
camera changes,
lighting changes,
and unintended scene reconstruction.
```

其中最重要的是 `action_description`。这部分不能偷懒。

比如你前面的“闪身步”，不要只写：

```text
follow the original motion
```

而应该反推成：

```text
The subject begins standing near the center of the frame.

The body rapidly shifts laterally.
One foot steps strongly sideways while the opposite foot follows.
The stance opens wider.
The knees flex naturally.
The center of gravity moves sideways.
The torso leans slightly with the movement.
The arms swing naturally for balance.

After reaching the widest lateral position,
the subject quickly returns toward the original centered stance.

After a short pause,
the lateral dodge-step is repeated,
then the subject returns to the centered neutral position.
```

模型拿到这种描述，才真正知道你想保留的是：

**横移距离、脚步、重心、侧倾、速度、回正时间。**

双人时则在母版中间额外增加：

```text
subject_mapping:

<Subject 1> must replace the tracked subject on the LEFT side.

<Subject 2> must replace the tracked subject on the RIGHT side.

This mapping is fixed throughout the entire video.

Never swap the two identities.

Preserve:
their relative positions,
distance,
eye-line relationship,
body orientation,
interaction timing,
and depth ordering.
```

车辆或者物体也是完全同样的规范，只是把：

`face / hairstyle / clothing`

换成：

`vehicle body / wheels or tracks / turret / materials / proportions`

把动作描述换成：

`trajectory / turning / yaw / pitch / roll / acceleration / ground contact`

所以以后你这条流的提示词不需要分成“换人提示词”“坦克提示词”“双人提示词”三个完全不同体系。

应该统一成：

> **定义主体 → 定义原视频 → 定义 Depth 职责 → 锁定目标映射 → 反推动作 → 总结任务 → 针对性禁止项。**

> **提示词不要替模型编动作，而要描述原视频已经发生的动作。**
